services.desc: Set sail with The Happy Captain for a relaxing 2-hour sunset cruise aboard our unique glass-bottom boat. As the sun dips low over the Gulf of Mexico, you’ll enjoy stunning views both above and below the surface - from vibrant marine life gliding beneath the boat to the breathtaking colors lighting up the sky. Glide across the calm, turquoise waters surrounding Key West while our friendly crew shares local stories and points out interesting sights along the way. Bring your camera, your favorite drink, and someone you love - this is the perfect way to wind down, celebrate, or simply soak in the magic of island time.
